captions.detailed: A compact, portable box fan with a light gray square housing and a fold-flat top carry handle. The front features an open grid-style plastic intake grille, behind which a dark multi-blade fan assembly is visible. A dark cylindrical control knob is mounted on the right side panel, and small black feet support the bottom. The carry handle folds flat against the top, the front grille can swing open on side hinges, and the control knob and fan blades rotate on their respective axes.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact portable box fan in CadQuery. The model must feature a square main housing, a front grid-patterned grille, a side-mounted control knob, a top folding handle, and an internal multi-blade fan assembly, with appropriate rotational hinges and continuous spin articulations defined for the moving parts.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing using a hollowed-out box primitive with a large cylindrical cutout for the fan chamber. Build the front grille by creating a grid of intersecting thin rectangular plates, and attach it to the housing via side hinge cylinders. Model the fan assembly using a central cylindrical hub with angled extruded blade profiles, and place it on a continuous spin joint. Finally, add a cylindrical control knob on the right side panel and a curved sweep-profile handle on the top surface with revolute joints at the corners.
